messages:
matt_se: Quick sync — ByteBridge pilot acceptance gates and timelines. Need owners for integration deliverables and final acceptance criteria. Target go/no-go 2026-04-08. Can owners + ETA please? cc @jess_product @liam_eng @anya_success

jess_product: I'll own product acceptance criteria. Proposed success: 1) p95 latency < 500ms on customer test set, 2) end-to-end auth (SAML) working with their IdP, 3) no PII persisted in logs by default. I'll post a short doc with formal criteria by EOD Wed.

liam_eng: I'll take integration adapter + staging runner. ETA for adapter v1: Wed 2026-03-25. Need infra for perf runs (GPU). @sophia_sre can you confirm resource availability? Also FYI there's a PR (#612) that wires the new config — needs a quick review.

sophia_sre: Can confirm. Prefer 1x A100 for initial perf, 2x for full run. I'll open infra ticket today (INF-3492) and loop in eng-infra. Expect 1x A100 by 2026-03-22.

anya_success: I'll coordinate customer-side UAT windows. ByteBridge asked for 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-01 for end-user testing. That works if perf results are ready by 2026-03-27. I'll also confirm their network ops for allowlist.

matt_se: Noted. Any blockers we should call out now (certs, network, CRs)?

liam_eng: Two things: 1) Need SAML cert from customer (service account) + allowlist IPs; SE has the details. 2) GitHub PR #612 (adapter config) needs review from @jess_product and @matt_se before I can cut the RC.

jess_product: Reviewing PR #612 now, left a couple inline comments about config defaults. Should be able to approve by lunchtime.

deploy-bot: Staging environment updated: https://staging.redwood.internal/bytebridge — image: rwi/pilot-adapter:2026-03-17-rc2

liam_eng: Short perf test plan: run 10k requests across short/med/long seq lengths, concurrency 20, capture p95/p99 and token throughput. Quick script for perf run: ```bash
python perf_test.py --host https://staging.redwood.internal/bytebridge --concurrency 20 --duration 10m
```

sophia_sre: INF-3492 created: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INF-3492 — assigned to eng-infra, note requests: 1x A100 for initial, 2x A100 for final. ETA for initial allocation 2026-03-22.

anya_success: I'll send calendar invites for the 03/30–04/01 UAT slots once we confirm perf ETA. Also will ping their infra contact for the SAML cert and IP allowlist.

matt_se: Great — owners confirmed: product=jess_product, eng=liam_eng, infra=sophia_sre, success=anya_success. I'll summarize and add to the sales handoff doc later today. If anything slips, ping here. :thumbsup:

jess_product: ack :+1:

liam_eng: tagging follow-ups: I'll post the adapter RC link when PR is merged and call out the perf run results in this thread.

anya_success: thanks all — will keep customer expectations in sync.

matt_se: Thanks everyone. Next checkpoint: perf results by 2026-03-27, UAT invites 2026-03-28. If we hit those, go/no-go on 2026-04-08 looks good.
